hikes.name: Red Top Lookout
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a staffed lookout over the Teanaway, near agate beds.

hikes.name: Earl Peak
hikes.blurb: A big climb up a dry ridge to a summit facing the Stuart Range.

hikes.name: Frost Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Shoestring Trailhead, a 6.9-mile round trip to the top of Frost Mountain (5,699 ft), with about 1,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Nelson Hill
hikes.blurb: From Pipe Creek Sno-Park, an 11.9-mile round trip to the top of Nelson Hill (5,175 ft), with about 2,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Thea Lake
hikes.blurb: From Mission Ridge Trailhead, a 3.7-mile round trip to Thea Lake, with about 750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Lost Lake
hikes.blurb: From Manastash Trailhead, a 3.1-mile round trip to Lost Lake, with about 550 feet of climbing.
